title: Choose Communitator’s visual world
question: Choose the world that should guide the new VitePress site, or re-roll the hand.

options.label: The Assembly Docket
options.lineage: co-operative meeting packets and community noticeboards
options.thesis: Communitator becomes the working packet a community leader brings to the table, marks up, and passes on.
options.viewport: A full-width assembly sheet turns one relay policy into a visible route from leader to community, with the shareable template as the hand-off artifact.
options.risk: The paper language must stay operational and current, never drift into scrapbook nostalgia.

raised.raise: Every route mark, state, and accent now derives from one repeatable template grammar.
Dense configuration details receive uncompromising alignment and information rhythm.
The visitor’s last useful step remains visibly marked across the reading journey.
Each configuration phase carries a text label and pattern, never color alone.
The whole page reads as one continuous section through a community’s setup.

options.label: Broadcast Control Log
options.lineage: community radio control rooms and station logs
options.thesis: A relay template reads like a live broadcast chain: sources patched, levels checked, transmission handed to the community.
options.viewport: A wide control surface makes the three event kinds and their destinations legible at a glance, then opens into a leader’s field guide.
options.risk: It is the most familiar metaphor for relays and can become predictable if treated as decorative audio equipment.

options.label: Relay Patent Sheet
options.thesis: The complete relay template is shown as one exploded invention whose numbered parts resolve into an exact specification.
options.viewport: A responsive exploded routing figure connects relay permissions, Blossom servers, DM relays, and signed events with numbered leaders.
options.case: Product clarity is exceptional because every part maps to a specification; community identity is less immediate than the assembly packet.
options.risk: It can imply legal complexity unless the prose remains unusually plain.

options.label: Parametric Community Mark
options.thesis: Each relay configuration seeds a distinct identity that recolors and reshapes the documentation around it.
options.viewport: A live mark expands into the configured network while the surrounding page adopts the same seed.
options.case: The generated identity competes with the practical task and is not part of community leaders’ current workflow.
options.kept: One source of truth governs every visual state.
options.risk: Variation can weaken recognition and make screenshots inconsistent.

options.label: Data Sublime
options.thesis: Relay traffic becomes a black-and-white field of exact event columns and transmission bands.
options.viewport: A dense routing field resolves into kinds 10002, 10063, and 10050 as the visitor selects each band.
options.case: It lowers newcomer clarity and does not identify the community-leader use scene.
options.kept: Treat dense technical information as composition, not residue.
options.risk: High density and inversion are exhausting in a reading surface.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: film select rails and work prints
options.thesis: The setup journey advances as a strip of inspected frames, with deferred details kept on reachable pins.
options.viewport: The creator-to-member journey scrubs across fixed frames and stops at the shareable template hand-off.
options.case: The linear edit metaphor obscures a configuration that branches by relay type.
options.kept: Persist and re-mark the reader’s last useful position.
options.risk: Horizontal scrubbing can fight long-form documentation.

options.label: Relay Dawn
options.thesis: A community network moves from blackout to fully connected day through inspectable configuration cues.
options.viewport: A horizon shifts through named relay states while the three signed events become visible actors.
options.case: The atmospheric transition is memorable but too indirect for configuration documentation.
options.kept: Name every color state and provide a motion-free equivalent.
options.risk: The story can promise spectacle where readers need exact instructions.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: A continuous cutaway shows information entering, warming, and leaving each room of a community network.
options.viewport: One long section follows a template from leader through signing to the relay destinations beyond.
options.case: The continuous journey is clear, but the architectural scene does not belong naturally to community operators.
options.kept: Make the whole site read as one continuous, inhabited section.
options.risk: The metaphor can become more visible than the product mechanism.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished open-source product landing page followed by conventional documentation.
canonCard.viewport: A centered headline, two actions, a product graphic, and a familiar three-feature row.
canonCard.risk: Easy to navigate and equally easy to confuse with another Nostr tool.
